title: Never below zero
prompt: A member `health` at 20. A hit can never take the robot below zero: health_floor takes 50 damage through a `take_damage` helper and reports 0, not -30.
hints: take_damage subtracts first, then checks the floor at 0; health_floor calls take_damage(50) and returns health.

docs.name: var name = value (outside any function)
docs.what: A variable at the top of the script (a member variable): every function in the script can read and change it.
